item.title: Restitution of Results from Projet DevOCGen
item.dc:creator: Miguel de Navascués
item.description: Last 1-4 December there was the restitution week for the project DevOCGen (Développement et applications de nouveaux outils pour la gestion et la conservation des populations naturelles à partir de données génomiques). Today the presentation slides are available here. There were talks about haplotagging, genetic studies of endangered species in the Occitanie region and methods to estimate demography, population size and population fragmentation from molecular markers. There were also workshops about the methods developped during the project that are available here.

item.title: Webinar about Peer Community In
item.dc:creator: Miguel de Navascués
item.description: Last 13 january 2026 there was a Webinar organised by INRAE’s ECODIV division about Peer Community In (PCI) and Peer Community Journal (PCJ). There were several presentations, and among them I presented PCI Evolutionary Biology. The whole seminar (2h, in French) is available in YouTube.

item.title: GDR-AIEM : annual meeting 2025
item.dc:creator: Miguel de Navascués
item.description: Last 5 to 7 November 2025 there was the Annual Meeting of the GDR-AIEM in Saint-Martin-de-Londres (France). Two people from our group at CBGP presented their work. Paul Bunel, presented his work on the use of Hidden Markov Models for the inference of effective population size and selection coefficient of loci under selection from temporal series of genetic data (Uhl et al. 2025). Jules Romieu presented his work using simulation-based inference for characterizing the proportion of the genome that is affected by adaptive introgression.
